name: Do I need architectural plans and permits for a garage addition?

mainEntity.name: Do I need architectural plans and permits for a garage addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, architectural plans and permits are almost always required for a garage addition, as it involves significant structural changes, foundation work, and often utility extensions. The specific requirements can vary based on local building codes in cities like Fort Worth, Alameda, Albany, or Berkeley. Our integrated design-build process includes comprehensive permit coordination, handling all necessary documentation and submissions on your behalf. This ensures your project complies with all local regulations, avoiding delays and ensuring a smooth progression from concept to completion, providing homeowners with a single, accountable team for this critical step.
